summary: Freedom Metals Acquisition Corp., a blank-check company, filed an 8-K reporting the consummation of its initial public offering (IPO) of 27,500,000 units at $10.00 per unit, generating $275 million in gross proceeds. Each unit consists of one Class A ordinary share and one-third of a redeemable warrant exercisable at $11.50 per share. The underwriters include Cohen Company Capital Markets and Clear Street LLC, acting as representatives. The filing is a standard SPAC IPO closing report and does not involve a special situation such as a business combination, tender offer, or other transformative event. No deal terms for an acquisition are stated. What to watch: the SPAC has 18-24 months to identify a target.
